nedee3d2705.headline: Power tariffs: Will Umeme’s exit usher in cheaper power?
nedee3d2705.summary: The article asks whether Umeme's exit will usher in cheaper power for Ugandans, noting that electricity prices have drawn comments from the president. Umeme was the country's main electricity distributor.
nedee3d2705.why: Electricity tariffs affect the cost of doing business and the competitiveness of industry. Umeme was Uganda's main electricity distribution company before its exit.

n75fcfa8144.headline: MTN cuts core infrastructure spending as capex soars to N1.53tn
n75fcfa8144.summary: MTN Nigeria lowered spending on core infrastructure projects in 2024, even as its capital expenditure soared 168.3 per cent to N1.53 trillion. The increase was largely driven by other spending.
n75fcfa8144.why: MTN Nigeria is a leading mobile operator in Nigeria, and capital spending levels affect its network investment and cash flow.

na0f54abb80.headline: What to know about the minerals in the US-Ukraine deal
na0f54abb80.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky will meet President Donald Trump on Friday to sign an agreement that would allow the United States access to Ukraine's minerals.
na0f54abb80.why: Access to critical minerals affects supply chains for strategic metals and shapes US-Ukraine economic and security ties.

nf18042955a.headline: KEPCO to pay dividend for 1st time in 4 years
nf18042955a.summary: Korea Electric Power Corp. said it will resume dividend payments for the first time in four years. The decision is driven by strong earnings performance.
nf18042955a.why: KEPCO is South Korea's state-controlled electric utility and dominant power company, so its payout policy matters for the country's energy sector and investors.

ne549758f3d.headline: Supreme Court blocks Rivers funds, recognises Amaewhule assembly
ne549758f3d.summary: Nigeria's Supreme Court stopped the Central Bank of Nigeria and the Accountant-General of the Federation from releasing funds. The ruling also recognised the Amaewhule assembly.
ne549758f3d.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria and the Accountant-General control federal payments to states, so court orders on fund releases affect government finances.

na80da9bdaa.headline: House prices rise as first-time buyers race to beat stamp duty hike
na80da9bdaa.summary: Nationwide says average house prices have risen 0.4% since January, as transactions pick up. First-time buyers are racing to beat a stamp duty increase.
na80da9bdaa.why: UK house prices feed into mortgage lending, household wealth and the Bank of England's assessment of the economy.

n2274c2c0df.headline: Fed seen restarting rate cuts in June as still-elevated inflation slows
n2274c2c0df.summary: The US Federal Reserve is seen restarting interest rate cuts in June as inflation, though still elevated, slows. The benchmark rate is currently at 4.25%-4.50%.
n2274c2c0df.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields, equity valuations and the dollar worldwide.
n2274c2c0df.why_moved: Expectations that the Fed will restart rate cuts as inflation slows shift the outlook for borrowing costs and asset prices.

nf576162ff5.headline: Alibaba, Tencent, and GDS Holdings Fell as Trump Ratchets Up Tariff Talk
nf576162ff5.summary: Chinese stocks fell after President Trump said additional tariffs on Chinese imports were slated to take effect Tuesday. Alibaba shares traded 2.7% lower and Tencent 2.4% lower, while GDS initially slid almost 8% before recouping most losses.
nf576162ff5.why: Alibaba and Tencent are major Chinese internet companies whose US-listed shares are sensitive to US-China trade policy and China's economic outlook.

impacts.why: Shares traded 2.7% lower as tariff concerns rose.

n0ab84e2db7.headline: Drought-hit Morocco urges people not to buy sheep for Eid al-Adha
n0ab84e2db7.summary: Drought has reduced Morocco's herd and prices are rising amid inflation. King Mohammed VI has asked the public to refrain from slaughtering sheep for Eid al-Adha.
n0ab84e2db7.why: Drought-driven livestock shortages push up food prices, which feed into inflation and household budgets in import-reliant economies.

nc3c3ed194b.headline: In child care centers and on farms, businesses are bracing for more immigration raids
nc3c3ed194b.summary: Child care centers and farms are preparing for more immigration raids as the Trump administration's mass deportation stance puts employers of people without legal status on notice.
nc3c3ed194b.why: Agriculture and childcare rely heavily on immigrant labour, so enforcement actions can raise staffing costs and disrupt operations in those sectors.

n74cf7df246.headline: Meeting Trump at White House, Zelenskyy hopes for continued aid in war with Russia
n74cf7df246.summary: Zelenskyy met Trump at the White House and hoped for continued aid in the war with Russia. The meeting came about a week after Trump called him a dictator.
n74cf7df246.why: US military and financial aid to Ukraine affects defence spending, European security and the outlook for energy and commodity markets.

nbe2c9af9ad.headline: Japanese Yen Declines as Tokyo Core CPI Eases
nbe2c9af9ad.summary: The Japanese yen extended its losses on Friday, with USD/JPY trading at 150.39, up 0.40% on the day. The move followed the easing of Tokyo core CPI.
nbe2c9af9ad.why: The yen's exchange rate affects Japanese import costs, exporter earnings and the Bank of Japan's policy considerations.

impacts.why: The yen weakened against the dollar on the day, with USD/JPY rising 0.40% as the data eased.

nf1e2c29edd.headline: Adebajo reveals most important thing as Tinubu signs N54.99tn 2025 budget
nf1e2c29edd.summary: President Bola Tinubu has signed the N54.99 trillion 2025 budget. Commentary from CFG Advisory's Adetilewa Adebajo focused on the non-allocation of funds to fuel subsidy.
nf1e2c29edd.why: Nigeria's federal budget sets public spending and borrowing needs, which affect fiscal stability, naira assets and sovereign bond investors.

nc926e166f4.headline: India, Japan renew USD 75 bn  bilateral currency swap agreement
nc926e166f4.summary: India and Japan have renewed the USD 75 billion bilateral currency swap agreement, the Reserve Bank said in a statement. The arrangement lets both authorities swap currencies in either direction.
nc926e166f4.why: Bilateral swap lines between central banks provide foreign currency liquidity in a crisis and support currency stability for both economies.

n9c7e2403ac.headline: Australian shares hit eight-week low as slide continues
n9c7e2403ac.summary: The ASX 200 finished 1.2% lower, with February set to be its worst month in more than two years. The index has extended its slide.
n9c7e2403ac.why: The ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies across sectors such as banking, mining and healthcare.
n9c7e2403ac.why_moved: Continued selling pushed the index to an eight-week low, extending its slide.

ne58b08c4f4.headline: Russia Bought Renault's Plants For 1 Cent, Now Wants $1.3 Billion To Sell Back | Carscoops
ne58b08c4f4.summary: Russia is now asking $1.3 billion to sell back Renault's former plants, which were acquired for one cent. Renault once controlled about 30% of Russia's car market.
ne58b08c4f4.why: Renault is a French automaker whose Russian operations were a major part of its international business before its 2022 exit.

n968f2b4b0f.headline: AI robots may hold key to nursing Japan's aging population
n968f2b4b0f.summary: An AI-driven robot in Tokyo was shown gently repositioning a man lying on his back. The report suggests such robots may help address nursing needs in Japan's aging population.
n968f2b4b0f.why: Japan has one of the world's oldest populations, creating structural labour shortages in elder care. Automation and robotics firms are positioned to benefit if adoption expands.

n9fb42c35d4.headline: Trump’s Tariff Threat: USD/CAD Hits Three-Week High
n9fb42c35d4.summary: USD/CAD has climbed since mid-February toward a three-week high as a one-month tariff delay approaches its end. The pair had earlier reached a 22-year high after tariffs were announced in February.
n9fb42c35d4.why: The USD/CAD exchange rate reflects the relative strength of the US dollar and the Canadian dollar, and Canada is highly exposed to US trade policy. Tariff changes can move the loonie and Canadian exporters.

impacts.name: USD/CAD
impacts.why: Tariff uncertainty tied to US trade policy is pushing the pair higher as the delay approaches its end.

n932c497c2e.headline: India's foreign exchange reserves rise to two-month high
n932c497c2e.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves rose to a two-month high of $640.48 billion as of February 21, the central bank data showed. Reserves increased by $4.76 billion in the week.
n932c497c2e.why: Foreign exchange reserves help the Reserve Bank of India defend the rupee and manage external financing risks. Changes signal shifts in external buffers.

n75c9dac772.headline: BA owner to give £830M back to shareholders as profits hit record high
n75c9dac772.summary: The Aer Lingus and British Airways owner said operating profit rose 22.1% to €4.3 billion in 2024, from €3.5 billion a year earlier. It will return £830 million to shareholders.
n75c9dac772.why: International Consolidated Airlines Group owns British Airways, Iberia, Aer Lingus and Vueling. Its results and shareholder payouts are closely watched by airline investors.

ncbcf82895d.headline: Koreans become increasingly afraid of starting new business
ncbcf82895d.summary: New business formations in Korea in 2024 were the lowest since records began in 2016. The figures came amid a deepening economic downturn.
ncbcf82895d.why: New business formation is a leading indicator of entrepreneurship, job creation and economic dynamism. Weak startup activity can signal weaker long-term growth prospects.

n0241dd1523.headline: Ireland consumer prices increase, retail sales volumes fall
n0241dd1523.summary: Ireland's retail sales volume fell in January, while consumer goods and service prices grew over the past year. The figures were published by the Central Statistics Office.
n0241dd1523.why: Consumer prices and retail volumes are key gauges of Irish household spending and inflation trends that influence central bank policy.

nac1591ff7c.headline: Trump's tariff threats could undermine future trade deals
nac1591ff7c.summary: President Donald Trump said 25% tariffs on Mexican and Canadian imports would go live as scheduled next week, potentially undermining a trade deal he had reached.
nac1591ff7c.why: Tariffs on North America's largest trading partners affect cross-border supply chains, autos, energy and currencies such as the Mexican peso and Canadian dollar.
nac1591ff7c.why_moved: The announcement that 25% tariffs on Mexican and Canadian imports would take effect next week raises trade-war risk and could undermine the trade deal Trump had reached.

ndb5bf6a808.headline: New scheme for public tenders covering both pilot and deployment phases; simpler tenders for construction, ICT
ndb5bf6a808.summary: A new scheme for public tenders covers both pilot and deployment phases, with simpler tenders for construction and ICT. The changes aim to make government procurement more accessible to SMEs.
ndb5bf6a808.why: Government procurement rules determine how public contracts are awarded, which affects construction and technology firms bidding for public work.

n6c840446fc.headline: Government spending, rural boom lift India’s GDP to 6.2% in Q3 FY25 - BusinessToday
n6c840446fc.summary: India's GDP grew 6.2% in the third quarter of FY25, supported by government spending and a rural boom. The rate was below the 8.6% recorded in the same quarter a year earlier.
n6c840446fc.why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies, so GDP trends shape investor expectations for Indian equities, the rupee and the central bank's policy path.

n344a3ee7c4.headline: Cement maker Holcim beats earnings forecasts in fourth quarter
n344a3ee7c4.summary: Holcim reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings on Friday. The Swiss building materials company is pressing ahead with its plan to spin off its North American business.
n344a3ee7c4.why: Holcim is a global cement and building materials maker, and its results and portfolio changes signal demand and cost trends in construction markets.

impacts.why: Earnings beat and ongoing spin-off plan directly concern Holcim's results and corporate structure.

nc9543d0737.summary: Korean stocks fell more than 3% on Friday, dragged down by a possible tariff war threat from US President Donald Trump and a slump in AI-related shares. The won fell to a three-week low.
nc9543d0737.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, and Korean exporters and chipmakers are sensitive to US trade policy and AI demand.

nca02aa278d.headline: India and EU to Finalize Free Trade Agreement by Year-end
nca02aa278d.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India will finalise a mutually beneficial bilateral free trade agreement with the EU by the end of this year. He spoke after meeting EU chief Ursula von der Leyen in New Delhi.
nca02aa278d.why: A free trade agreement between India and the EU would lower tariffs and shape trade flows between two large economies.

n45b6190a38.headline: Tariffs and Triathlon Products – What Might Go Up? - Slowtwitch News
n45b6190a38.summary: President Trump announced another round of tariffs on Chinese goods. Analysts are weighing how the measures might affect multisport product prices.
n45b6190a38.why: US tariffs on Chinese imports raise costs for importers and can shift global trade flows and corporate margins.

nbd4708bd70.headline: Blow for hard-pressed households as shock hike in electricity and gas bills is confirmed
nbd4708bd70.summary: SSE Airtricity confirmed a rise in electricity and gas prices, saying the decision responds to increases in its external costs.
nbd4708bd70.why: Energy tariffs feed directly into household budgets and inflation, and retail supplier costs reflect wholesale energy markets.

n4a48d92be0.headline: UK's FTSE 100 outperforms Europe on robust corporate earnings
n4a48d92be0.summary: Britain's FTSE 100 bucked the global gloom on Friday, driven by earnings-related moves in several stocks including IAG, while investors awaited a key U.S. inflation reading.
n4a48d92be0.why: The FTSE 100 is the UK's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, heavily weighted to global earners.

n29ae09134c.headline: No place to hide from Trump tariff worries
n29ae09134c.summary: A MarketScreener day-ahead preview says worries about the destabilising and economically destructive potential of Donald Trump's tariffs have been building for a long time.
n29ae09134c.why: Tariffs change trade costs and corporate margins across many sectors, so shifts in tariff policy are closely watched by global investors.

n64e6c8347b.headline: State Street to Acquire Mizuho Financial Group’s Global Custody Business
n64e6c8347b.summary: State Street and Mizuho Financial Group have agreed that State Street will acquire Mizuho's global custody and related businesses outside of Japan.
n64e6c8347b.why: State Street is a major US custodian bank that holds and services assets for institutional investors. Custody is a large fee-based business, so acquisitions here expand scale in asset servicing.

n3138afa416.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street rallies, and Dow jumps 600 to make a dreary February not so bad
n3138afa416.summary: US stock indexes rallied as Wall Street closed a dreary February on a brighter note, with the Dow jumping 600 points.
n3138afa416.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US companies and is a widely followed gauge of US equity market sentiment.
n3138afa416.why_moved: US stock indexes rallied at the close of February, with the Dow up 600 points, according to the report.

n943ff4fafc.headline: Japan's Tokyo CPI slows to 2.2% yoy in Feb, industrial production down -1.1% mom in Jan
n943ff4fafc.summary: Tokyo core CPI slowed to 2.2% year on year in February from 2.5%, below expectations of 2.3%, partly due to reintroduced energy subsidies. Core-core CPI held at 1.9%.
n943ff4fafc.why: Consumer price inflation in Tokyo is a leading indicator for Japan's national inflation, which shapes Bank of Japan policy and bond yields.

nf7622b1b54.headline: Worry as Vietnam slashes jobs - Taipei Times
nf7622b1b54.summary: Vietnam approved a radical government cost-cutting drive last week, with ministries being scrapped and public sector workers facing job losses, according to a Taipei Times report.
nf7622b1b54.why: Public sector restructuring changes government spending and administrative capacity, which can affect fiscal policy and business conditions.

n9c5818c488.headline: Life insurer income hits new high - Taipei Times
n9c5818c488.summary: Taiwan's life insurers posted pretax earnings of NT$32.1 billion in January, the highest for the same period in three years, Financial Supervisory Commission data showed.
n9c5818c488.why: Life insurers are large institutional investors in bonds and equities, so their profitability affects capital flows in local financial markets.

ndc1da87130.headline: Laugfs Gas says no price revision in March
ndc1da87130.summary: Laugfs Gas PLC said it will not revise domestic LP gas prices for March 2025, according to Cluster Director and CEO Dr. Niroshan J Peiris.
ndc1da87130.why: Laugfs Gas is a Sri Lankan liquefied petroleum gas retailer, and LP gas pricing affects household and commercial energy costs in the country.

nc81b1f44bc.headline: Hutchison Ports presents $1bn investment plan to modernise Pakistan’s ports
nc81b1f44bc.summary: Hutchison Ports, a major port operator, presented a $1 billion investment plan to modernise Pakistan's ports.
nc81b1f44bc.why: Hutchison Ports is a global container terminal operator, and port investment affects trade capacity and logistics costs for importers and exporters.

n145d0d4a9f.headline: Vendors: Onion prices high due to weather
n145d0d4a9f.summary: A local vendors group says weather disturbances affecting Luzon in the last quarter of 2024 are believed to be behind higher red onion prices. The report was published by SunStar.
n145d0d4a9f.why: Onions are a staple food crop in the Philippines, and price swings feed directly into household inflation. Weather shocks are a common driver of agricultural price volatility.

nd94a169fc9.headline: Toronto Stocks Unchanged; Docebo Shares Slide on Lower-Than-Expected 1Q Targets
nd94a169fc9.summary: Docebo shares fell after its first-quarter targets came in below expectations. Toronto-listed stocks were roughly flat at midday, with mixed sector performance.
nd94a169fc9.why: Docebo is a Toronto-based provider of learning management software, sold mainly to businesses. Its quarterly targets are closely watched by investors in Canadian technology stocks.

ne55ad56ac9.headline: Ex-Marcos family employee nabbed
ne55ad56ac9.summary: A former employee linked to President Marcos's family was detained for allegedly defrauding people through fake government projects in Pasay City.
ne55ad56ac9.why: This event is a legal matter with potential implications for governance and public trust, but less direct economic impact.

nf5c32cafb5.headline: British woman who moved to Spain shares supermarket bill – cost floors Brits
nf5c32cafb5.summary: A British expatriate living in Spain shared her supermarket bill, illustrating rising living costs for Brits abroad.
nf5c32cafb5.why: Cost of living differences impact consumer behavior and expatriate economic activity.

nff2728c0df.headline: Why Rocket Lab Stock Dropped Then Popped Today
nff2728c0df.summary: Rocket Lab's stock saw fluctuations today, reflecting investor reactions to recent developments.
nff2728c0df.why: Stock volatility can indicate investor sentiment and affect market capitalization of the aerospace company.

nd0e190bae1.headline: Cabinet amending rules to boost parental leave - Taipei Times
nd0e190bae1.summary: Taiwan's Executive Yuan proposes increasing parental leave from six to seven months, aiming to support work-life balance.
nd0e190bae1.why: Changes in parental leave policies can influence labor costs and workforce participation in Taiwan's economy.
